name_reason: Convention-compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=audio, descriptor=sfx_sample_handle_0. Reflects data type (opaque AIL sample handle, scalar). The _0 suffix is a meaningful channel/slot index, NOT Ghidra address residue: the sibling data_fd2_audio_sfx_sample_handle_1 lives at 0x53EE8 and both are allocated consecutively via AIL_allocate_sample_handle in main; the address 0x53EE4 does not equal 0 (or any related hex), so _0 is a domain index that must be preserved.
purpose: AIL (Miles Sound System) DIG sample handle for SFX playback channel 0 -- the opaque handle argument threaded through the AIL one-shot SFX play sequence.
logic_summary: Zero-init (BSS) scalar dword. Allocated once at startup in main (0x25C4B) by AIL_allocate_sample_handle(data_fd2_audio_sfx_dig_driver_handle), gated on a non-NULL AIL_install_DIG_INI() result (same branch sets data_fd2_audio_sfx_driver_available_flag=1 and allocates the sibling handle_1). Thereafter read-only as the handle arg in fd2_play_sfx_with_handle (5 reads at 0x25AC7/0x25AFD/0x25B12/0x25B24/0x25B32) passed to AIL_stop_sample, AIL_init_sample, AIL_set_sample_address, AIL_set_sample_loop_count, AIL_start_sample.
datatype: void * / undefined4 (4-byte opaque AIL sample handle; Ghidra type undefined4, src declares void *; both 4 bytes on this 32-bit target)
element_semantics: Single scalar: opaque handle ID returned by AIL_allocate_sample_handle, identifying SFX playback channel 0. Not an array.
notes: BSS global in .object2 (image bytes all zero). src comment block (main.c lines 858-876) already precise and matches all xref/datatype evidence -> kept verbatim. Ghidra data plate was blank (PLATE=[null]); created a concise plate via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) reflecting the src conclusion (writer/readers/sibling). No src edit was made (comment kept), so the only staged source-tree change is this shard file. No logic/equivalence concerns.
